tagline: One-click Blender ↔ Maya transfers that keep your materials, geometry and hierarchy intact.

releases.title: AI assistants can frame and capture the ZBrush view

items.text: AI assistants working with ZBrush can now read and change the view: rotate, move and zoom the model, switch perspective, set the focal length or field of view, and frame either all visible SubTools or just the active one. They can also capture the current ZBrush view as an image to check their work.

releases.title: AI assistants can work with ZBrush

items.text: AI assistants using QuickExport's MCP server can now start ZBrush in the background, list its SubTools with their point and face counts, and move sculpts between Blender and ZBrush in both directions. Each import shows what it will add or replace first and reports exactly which SubTools were added, replaced or removed. ZBrush runs one copy at a time, so close ZBrush before an assistant starts it; connecting to an open ZBrush is not supported yet.

releases.title: Review exports with a hidden camera

items.text: AI-assisted review transfers now export when the scene camera or a light is hidden in the viewport, so the reviewed camera arrives in Maya.
AI-assisted selection now reports objects Blender could not select because they are hidden or locked.

releases.title: Connect MCP button visible in Maya settings

items.text: The Connect MCP and Disconnect MCP buttons in Quick Export Settings > Advanced were hidden behind Save Settings. They now show at the bottom of Advanced with the connection status on its own line, and the settings window is a bit more compact.

releases.title: Reinstall the ZBrush side with ZBrush open

items.text: Install ZBrush Side no longer fails while ZBrush is running and its QuickExport files are unchanged. If a changed file is in use, the error now tells you to close ZBrush instead of wrongly blaming the ZBrush 2026.0 startup folder.

releases.title: ZBrush 2026.0 install asks for administrator permission

items.text: Install ZBrush Side on ZBrush 2026.0 now shows the Windows administrator prompt when ZBrush's startup file can't be changed, instead of stopping with an error. Accept it once and the install finishes; ZBrush 2026.1+ never needs it.

releases.title: Python scripts from AI assistants in Blender

items.text: AI assistants connected to Blender with Connect MCP can now run a Python script when the built-in actions don't cover what they need, just like in Maya. They get the printed output and any error back, see which objects and meshes the script added or removed, can stop a long script, and in an open Blender each script is a single Ctrl+Z step.
QuickExport moves to the 4.12 release line. This version has the same features and fixes as 4.11.597; update both Blender and Maya to 4.12.0 so they stay in step.

Maya Rigged (Editable Rig) exports no longer load every image in the file each time. In scenes with many large textures, exporting a rig or a single object now takes about a second instead of several, and textures the export doesn't use stay unloaded.

releases.title: Display As carries over to Maya

items.text: Objects set to Display As Bounds or Wire in Blender (Object Properties > Viewport Display) now show the same way in Maya: as a bounding box or as wireframe. Maya only draws box bounds, so Sphere, Cylinder, Cone and Capsule bounds become a box, with a note in the import warnings.

AI assistants connected to Blender through the QuickExport MCP server can now prepare a bug report the same way the Send Report button does, attach their renders, logs and transfer files, and show you exactly what is inside before anything is sent. Nothing is uploaded until it is explicitly submitted, and an interrupted upload picks up where it stopped.

Install ZBrush Side now installs QuickExport into every ZBrush 2026+ on your machine, not just the newest. A version it can't install into (never opened yet, or 2026.0 without admin rights) is skipped with a note saying why, and the others still install.
Install ZBrush Side works when more than one ZBrush version is installed: it picks the asset folder that belongs to the ZBrush it installs into
Meshes under a moved group or parent no longer shift when sent to ZBrush and back. Grouping a ZBrush import and moving the group keeps it in place too.
The shelf Import button picks up meshes sent from ZBrush when they are newer than the latest Blender transfer.
The shelf Export button works in ZBrush mode and uses the ZBrush Export Scale.
Objects parented to an offset empty no longer shift when sent to ZBrush and back. Moving the parent later keeps the export in place too.
ZBrush 2026.1 and newer: Install ZBrush Side now puts the QuickExport menu where ZBrush finds it. Reinstall if the menu was missing.
Meshes coming back from ZBrush replace their match directly, so imports are faster. Your Tool is still backed up.
Parented objects go to ZBrush and back in their parent's space, so hierarchies keep their transforms.
ZBrush imports keep vertex groups, creases, seams, extra UV maps and UV map names, so modifiers keep working.
Keep UVMap option keeps Blender's UVs instead of the ones from ZBrush.
Gamma on non-negative colors builds a single node.
RGB Curves cover the full range of colors that reach them.
IES light profiles survive temp-folder cleanup on macOS and Linux.
World Environment Textures keep their interpolation in Arnold.
Import checks warn instead of failing, and an object that fails is skipped while the rest finish.
The import progress window stays above the main Maya window.
Extend, Clip and Mirror image extension carry over to Arnold.
Overwriting a scatter updates only its points when that's all that changed.
Rec.2020, Display P3 and ACES AP0 working spaces convert correctly.
Point instancers hide their prototype curves so Arnold renders them.

releases.title: Color spaces in any OCIO config

items.text: Every image texture carries its color space, matched by meaning even in renamed or custom OCIO configs.
QuickExport never writes a color space your Maya config lacks, and warns when Maya color management is off.
The import result lists any color spaces that were substituted.
World HDRIs use the same color space matching.
Image Texture interpolation, including Closest, carries over to Arnold.
Legacy Hue/Saturation shifts hue by the right amount.
Displacement Midlevel maps to Arnold's displacement zero value.
Wave, Gradient (Easing, Spherical, Quadratic, Diagonal) and legacy Invert build fewer nodes.
Mapping with linked Rotation, Location or Scale converts to a single matrix.
World color correction folds into the image node.
Objects with the same name never block an import; ones that can't be matched import alongside.
Re-importing a package replaces the real previous import, not your duplicates of it.
Children you added in Maya are relocked after they are carried over.
Objects with no geometry and no children are no longer transferred.
The QuickExport menu in Maya's top bar is gone; installing removes a leftover one.
Maya runs with a separate profile keep your OCIO config.
The App Integrations header ignores apps that aren't installed.
Imported objects are selected after every import.
Re-importing a World replaces it, keeps your work on it, and names it after the Blender World.
Imports override artist locks and skip only referenced nodes.
Repeat imports replace their previous import, including instanced targets; other instances keep a copy.
Re-exporting a selected armature replaces its rig without deleting objects that weren't exported.
Volume-only materials no longer get a placeholder surface shader.
Imports skip the confirm dialog when nothing would be replaced, and show progress in the main help line.
The world overwrite dialog opens straight away, and import popups plan the scene only once.
The world overwrite dialog gets Select and Add World.
Overwrites keep children you added in Maya, and you can roll back from the dialog.
A grayscale image plugged into a number input uses Alpha Is Luminance in any color space.
Converted scenes need only standard MtoA; QuickExport no longer ships its own Arnold plug-in.
Normal Map, Bump, Displacement and Voronoi use standard Arnold nodes, and Bump strength now matches Cycles.
Lights convert to standard Maya and Arnold lights.
The QE_World viewport scale defaults to 100.
Meshes with no faces are no longer imported into Maya.
Math, Vector Math, Mix, Noise, Checker, Radial Gradient, Fresnel, Layer Weight, HSV/HSL and Is Camera Ray all convert to standard Maya and Arnold nodes.
Baked volume density uses standard Arnold nodes.
The Maya overwrite dialog opens faster.
Export Temporary Copies refreshes the scene 6 times instead of 14.
Texture Coordinate outputs build fewer nodes, and a fixed transform folds into the node that reads it.
Mapping in Vector mode converts, and a Z-rotated UV Mapping into an image becomes a plain place2dTexture.
Gamma and linked Mapping controls are built from standard Maya and Arnold nodes.
A newer export than your Maya side can read now warns instead of blocking.
NLA-driven objects keep smart key sampling when exporting real keys.
Image color spaces map to the equivalent space in your Maya OCIO config, with a warning when it has none.
Legacy ACES 1.2 OCIO configs are recognised.
Unsupported Blender nodes are always skipped on import, so that setting is gone.
FBX exports refresh the scene once at the start.
Maya Rigged exports get a Sample Anim option: real keys by default, with per-object frame ranges and smart key reduction.
Editable Rig keeps Blender's own keys and tangents on plain control curves.
Baked FK animation is reduced to fewer keys.
Maya opened by QuickExport keeps your usual Autodesk user settings.
Scene, Editable Rig, ZBrush, Blend to X and World exports refresh the scene once instead of repeatedly.
Subdivision is only toggled on objects the selection actually depends on.
Invert and Multiply/Add nodes right after an image fold into the Maya File node.
A Color Ramp read as a number builds its luminance curve directly.
An image's color plugged into a number input uses Alpha Is Luminance on sRGB and Linear maps.

releases.title: One bad item no longer stops a transfer

items.text: A light whose node emission can't be read still exports as its base light, with a warning.
Instances of the same Blender light each get their own Maya light shape.
A material that can't convert is left out instead of stopping every other material.
Imports recover from a failed material, and a light or camera that fails to convert keeps its FBX node.
Warnings from individual objects are collected and shown together after export.
Export progress shows a Preparing step, and skips the Shaders step when materials are off.
The texture prompt offers Safe Unpack Textures, with clearer hints.
Open Last Export warns you instead of failing when the export folder is gone.
Select Overlapping no longer loses the objects it should select.

releases.title: Leaner shader graphs and faster instancers

items.text: Hue/Saturation/Value becomes a single Arnold color-correct node for any color range.
Image textures read their own UV set directly, so UV Map nodes no longer add extra Maya nodes.
Displacement now drives Arnold scalar displacement along the object normal, with Midlevel as the zero point.
Shared texture placement nodes are labelled with the Blender Mapping node they come from.
Point instancers from scene transfers build much faster on large scatters.
Import progress no longer forces a viewport redraw on every update, so big imports finish sooner.
PointClouds and Prototypes helper groups are hidden as groups, so their contents stay visible when you need them.
Gamma matches Cycles for linked and negative inputs (Gamma 0 renders white, as in Blender).
Subsurface color is left unconnected when Subsurface Weight is 0, avoiding needless nodes.
Every rebuilt Maya shading node is tagged with the Blender node it reproduces.
An identity Mapping node passes its vector straight through instead of adding nodes.
Missing-image Alpha placeholders can be connected again.
Static scatter particles no longer behave like dynamics on timeline changes.
Float math stays single-channel and colors convert per node, giving smaller, more faithful graphs.
Export Dismiss is now a compact icon so stage labels fit.
Export progress only moves forward across phases.
Keep scene materials skips rebuilding materials for kept objects and retains their full upstream graph.
The import confirmation dialog closes before the import starts.
Geometry Nodes prototypes split by material become a single group instancer.
Each Geometry Nodes Object reference keeps its own prototype instead of collapsing into one.
Every Geometry Nodes mesh occurrence is instanced natively in Maya, with no placed mesh copies.
Instancer shear and collapsed scales carry over exactly.
Principled Volume connects to the shading group's Volume Shader slot.
Imported instancing owners are grouped under a plain transform.
Imports go straight through when nothing from the previous import is left in the scene.
Static scene transfers no longer create selection sets.
Removed helper-text labels from the scene transfer panel.
Static scene transfers no longer add role display layers to your scene.

releases.title: Scene transfer is out of Experimental

items.text: Maya scene transfers drop the Experimental label.
The UV option is now called Skip Inactive UV Maps.
Scene transfers replace same-named Maya objects on first import, just like FBX.
Import dialog gains an Advanced section and a clearer script path layout.
Editable Rig imports show Importing Geometry while geometry loads.
New Include FBX Option preference (off by default).
Maya export settings are simplified: rarely changed options are locked to sensible defaults.
Noise Texture distortion uses Arnold's own noise distortion.
Distorted and fractional-detail Noise rebuild from a couple of native nodes instead of large math networks.
Scalar graph results skip an unnecessary color conversion.
Shader Editor highlights which nodes convert to Maya, with per-node support notes and partial conversions marked yellow.
New QuickExport World panel in Properties > World.
Shared meshes arrive as native Maya point instancers.
Object Info Random carries over for objects and instances.
Editable rebuilds for Wave, Radial gradient, Voronoi, Checker, RGB Curves, Clamp, Map Range (all modes), Fresnel and Layer Weight.
Normal Map, Bump and Displacement chains rebuild as one native graph; Bump distance respects scene units.
Mix and Add Shader trees convert as nested closures, keeping their factors and transparency.
Noise fBM rebuilds as a single native Arnold noise node; constant nodes are folded away.
Textures follow the Blender image color space, including on data sockets.
Orthographic camera framing and lens shift survive the transfer.
Geometry is kept when an individual material fails to convert.
Long Windows texture paths no longer break Arnold texture conversion.
Invalid imports cancel with a clear warning.
Isolated mesh vertices are kept without turning into rendered spheres.
Mark Asset keeps geometry and hierarchy across every placement mode.
Mark Asset is faster on large selections.
Maya Rigged exports default to Editable Rig.
Material exports complete reliably even without progress updates.
Selection works on Windows systems that don't report their architecture.
Mixed procedural colors and the source BSDF behaviour are preserved.
Unshaded subgroup markers no longer interfere with preserved materials.
Review and studio previews use a bundled HDRI, so no download is needed.
Per-face shading assignments survive ordinary replacement.
Materials and hierarchy are preserved when FBX meshes and bones share names.
FBX overwrite resolves object names without grabbing matching rig joints.
Children keep their exact place in the hierarchy during FBX replacement.

archive.summary: Blender normals transfer by default, scene World/HDRI transfer to Maya, Mark Asset for all object types, shared export naming, unused-shader pruning, uncompressed transfers for speed, Editable Rig packages importable back into Blender, and faster Blender and Maya startup.

Transfer progress on the matching Blender button, preserved USD subdivision schemes, editable volume density shaders, Cycles-matched skin SSS, safer rig overwrites and animation fixes, and clearer Maya FBX vs scene-transfer guidance.

New Maya scene transfer with evaluated geometry, animated native rig transfer, reviewed partial rig export, rig control colors in Maya, editable procedural shader graphs in Arnold, Blender-style collapsible export settings, and no more _S material suffixes.

FBX subgroup replacement with rollback, shape-key baking on export, Arnold ColorRamp and specular fixes, ZBrush workflow fixes, Maya setup and update-flow improvements, and preserved face materials on linked meshes.
